parameters.query: SELECT d.*, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.lead_score, c.client_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = d.contact_id AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as recent_activities, (SELECT MAX(la.created_at) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = d.contact_id) as last_activity, (SELECT la.activity_type FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = d.contact_id ORDER BY la.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as last_activity_type FROM deals d JOIN contacts c ON c.id = d.contact_id WHERE d.stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') ORDER BY d.deal_value DESC

UPDATE deals SET stage = '{{ $json.new_stage }}', probability = {{ $json.new_probability }}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.deal_id }}; INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) SELECT contact_id, 'deal_stage_changed', '{"from": "{{ $json.current_stage }}", "to": "{{ $json.new_stage }}", "reason": "{{ $json.reason }}"}'::jsonb, 5 FROM deals WHERE id = {{ $json.deal_id }};
